statement:
The record shows a request for "owner of the whole company's systems," but the contractor ctr-migration@vendor.io is only working on project P-4 for one week.

Per policy, contractors get access to the one project they work on and never ownership of the whole company's systems. Assigning the correct level
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the requested "owner of the whole company's systems" level violates the stated rule that contractors never get company-wide ownership.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
